blocks.en: We now construct a family of continuous waves that generalize the rarefaction waves for the single conservation law. As in the case of shocks, we prove the existence of $n$ curves emanating from a left state $\bm{u}^l$ giving the possible right states $\bm{u}^r$ that can be connected directly using a single rarefaction wave.
blocks.zh: 现在构造一个连续波族, 推广单个守恒律的稀疏波. 与激波情形一样, 将证明从左状态 $\bm{u}^l$ 出发的 $n$ 条曲线的存在性, 它们给出可由单个稀疏波直接连接的所有可能的右状态 $\bm{u}^r$.

blocks.en: Let $\bm{u}$ be a $C^1$ solution of conservation law \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} in a domain $D$. Then $\bm{u}$ is said to be a \textbf{k-rarefaction wave} (or a \textbf{k-simple wave}) if all $k$-Riemann invariants are constant in $D$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\bm{u}$ 为区域 $D$ 内守恒律 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} 的一个 $C^1$ 解. 若所有 $k$-Riemann 不变量在 $D$ 内都为常数, 则称 $\bm{u}$ 为 \textbf{k-稀疏波} (或 \textbf{k-简单波}).
blocks.label: def:system-simple-wave

blocks.en: As we might have hoped from observing the results for the single conservation law, if we can find a rarefaction wave that fills in the blank wedge, the characteristics associated with $\lambda_k$ form a "fan."
blocks.zh: 正如从单个守恒律的结果所能期待的, 若能找到填满空白楔形区域的稀疏波, 则对应于 $\lambda_k$ 的特征线形成一个"扇形".

blocks.en: Let $\bm{u}$ be a $k$-rarefaction wave in a domain $D$. Then the characteristic curves $\hat x'(t)=\lambda_k(\bm{u}(\hat x(t),t))$ are straight lines along which $\bm{u}$ is constant.
blocks.zh: 设 $\bm{u}$ 为区域 $D$ 内的 $k$-稀疏波. 那么特征曲线 $\hat x'(t)=\lambda_k(\bm{u}(\hat x(t),t))$ 是直线, 且 $\bm{u}$ 沿这些直线为常数.
blocks.label: thm:system-rarefaction-straight-characteristics

blocks.en: The picture here is much the same as the one for the shock curves. The two rarefaction curves emanate from the left state $\bm{u}^l$; they share the tangent vectors $\bm{r}_k$ with the shock curves, but propagate in the opposite direction. The $R_1$ curve represents rarefaction waves in which both the left and right state have negative speed (sometimes called a slow wave or a back-wave) whereas the $R_2$ curve represents rarefaction waves in which both the left and right state have positive speed (fast waves or front-waves).
blocks.zh: 这里的图景与激波曲线的情形基本相同. 两条稀疏曲线都从左状态 $\bm{u}^l$ 出发; 它们与激波曲线具有相同的切向量 $\bm{r}_k$, 但沿相反方向传播. $R_1$ 曲线表示左状态与右状态的速度均为负的稀疏波 (有时称为慢波或后向波), 而 $R_2$ 曲线表示左状态与右状态的速度均为正的稀疏波 (快波或前向波).

blocks.zh: 一般解

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We now show how shocks and rarefaction waves can be put together to get a general solution for the Riemann problem. Our basic theorem is as follows.
blocks.zh: 现在说明如何将激波与稀疏波组合起来, 得到 Riemann 问题的一般解. 基本定理如下.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Suppose that our system of conservation laws \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} is strictly hyperbolic and genuinely nonlinear in a region $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ of state space. Then for any $\bm{u}^l\in\Omega$ there is a neighborhood $N\subset\Omega$ of $\bm{u}^l$ such that if $\bm{u}^r\in N$ there exists a weak solution of the Riemann problem \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}, \eqref{eq:riemann-piecewise-constant-data}. This solution is composed of at most $n+1$ constant states separated by rarefaction waves and shocks satisfying the Lax shock condition.
blocks.zh: 假设守恒律方程组 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system} 在状态空间的区域 $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ 内严格双曲且真正非线性. 那么对任意 $\bm{u}^l\in\Omega$, 都存在 $\bm{u}^l$ 的邻域 $N\subset\Omega$, 使得只要 $\bm{u}^r\in N$, Riemann 问题 \eqref{eq:conservation-law-system}, \eqref{eq:riemann-piecewise-constant-data} 就存在弱解. 该解由至多 $n+1$ 个常数状态组成, 这些状态由稀疏波及满足 Lax 激波条件的激波分隔.
blocks.label: thm:local-riemann-solution

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We will not prove this, but we show how the process works in the case of the $p$ system. We start with the left state $\bm{u}^l$ and consider the two pairs of shock and rarefaction curves emanating from that point. It is best to think of these as being two $C^1$ curves: a "slow curve" consisting of the union of $S_1$ and $R_1$ (the slow shocks and the slow rarefaction waves) and a "fast curve" consisting of the union of $S_2$ and $R_2$. Of course, if the right state $\bm{u}^r$ in our Riemann problem lies on either of these curves, we can simply connect the left and right state with a single wave (slow or fast, shock or rarefaction), depending on which of the four original curves it lies on. The question remains, what happens if the right state lies in one of the four open regions cut out by our curves?
blocks.zh: 不证明这一结果, 而是说明该过程如何在 $p$ 方程组的情形下实施. 从左状态 $\bm{u}^l$ 出发, 考虑由该点发出的两对激波曲线与稀疏曲线. 最好将它们看作两条 $C^1$ 曲线: 由 $S_1$ 和 $R_1$ 的并组成的"慢曲线" (慢激波与慢稀疏波), 以及由 $S_2$ 和 $R_2$ 的并组成的"快曲线". 当然, 若 Riemann 问题中的右状态 $\bm{u}^r$ 位于其中任一曲线上, 就可根据它位于原来四条曲线中的哪一条, 用单个波 (慢波或快波, 激波或稀疏波) 连接左状态与右状态. 剩下的问题是, 若右状态位于这些曲线划出的四个开区域之一, 会发生什么?

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The solution is obtained by covering these four regions with a family of fast curves. Through each point $\bar{\bm{u}}$ on the slow curve through $\bm{u}^l$ we can construct the curves $\bar S_2$ and $\bar R_2$. These new curves will represent shocks and rarefaction waves, respectively, all with positive speed and all having $\bar{\bm{u}}$ as the left state. Taking the union of $\bar S_2$ and $\bar R_2$ gives us a family of curves (which we will call the "fast family") parameterized by the points $\bar{\bm{u}}$ on the original slow curve. It is left as an exercise (cf. Problem~\ref{ex:p-system-fast-family-covering}) to show that there is a neighborhood $\mathcal N$ of $\bm{u}^l$ that is covered univalently by the fast family; i.e., for any point $\bm{u}^r\in\mathcal N$ there is exactly one member of the fast family containing $\bm{u}^r$.
blocks.zh: 用一个快曲线族覆盖这四个区域, 即可得到解. 对通过 $\bm{u}^l$ 的慢曲线上的每个点 $\bar{\bm{u}}$, 都可构造曲线 $\bar S_2$ 和 $\bar R_2$. 这些新曲线分别表示激波与稀疏波, 都具有正速度, 并都以 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 为左状态. 取 $\bar S_2$ 和 $\bar R_2$ 的并, 得到一个曲线族 (称为"快族"), 以原来慢曲线上的点 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 为参数. 以下事实留作练习 (参见 Problem~\ref{ex:p-system-fast-family-covering}): 存在 $\bm{u}^l$ 的邻域 $\mathcal N$, 它被快族单值覆盖; 即对任意点 $\bm{u}^r\in\mathcal N$, 快族中恰有一个成员包含 $\bm{u}^r$.

blocks.en: Now that we have used the left state to generate the slow curve and the fast family, the solution of the Riemann problem is simple. From any right state $\bm{u}^r\in\mathcal N$ we simply follow the appropriate member of the fast family back to a point $\bar{\bm{u}}$ on the slow curve. The point $\bar{\bm{u}}$ is now used as an intermediate state between two waves: a slow wave connecting $\bm{u}^l$ and $\bar{\bm{u}}$ and a fast wave connecting $\bar{\bm{u}}$ and $\bm{u}^r$. Of course, each of the two waves can be either a shock or rarefaction wave depending on which of the four regions defined by the original slow and fast curves the right state $\bm{u}^r$ lies in. The various possibilities are described in Figures~\ref{fig:slow-rarefaction-fast-shock}--\ref{fig:slow-rarefaction-fast-rarefaction}.
blocks.zh: 既然已利用左状态生成慢曲线与快族, Riemann 问题的求解就很简单了. 从任意右状态 $\bm{u}^r\in\mathcal N$ 出发, 只需沿快族中适当的成员返回慢曲线上的点 $\bar{\bm{u}}$. 现在将点 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 作为两个波之间的中间状态: 一个慢波连接 $\bm{u}^l$ 与 $\bar{\bm{u}}$, 一个快波连接 $\bar{\bm{u}}$ 与 $\bm{u}^r$. 当然, 两个波中的每一个都可以是激波或稀疏波, 取决于右状态 $\bm{u}^r$ 位于原来的慢曲线与快曲线所界定的四个区域中的哪一个. 各种可能性见 Figures~\ref{fig:slow-rarefaction-fast-shock}--\ref{fig:slow-rarefaction-fast-rarefaction}.
